About

Keemti Jewels, Andheri West, Mumbai

Witness the Brilliance of Fine Jewellery in Person

Address: Shop No 13-14, Unit No 102/A, New Link Palace Chs Ltd, Near Kamat Club, Village Oshiwara, Andheri West, Mumbai, Maharashtra- 400053

Phone: +91 865 263 5939

Store Timing: Mon – Sun: 11:00 AM – 8:30 PM

Keemti Jewels in Andheri West is where you can see our lab grown diamonds in Mumbai up close. The store is at New Link Palace, near Kamat Club in Oshiwara, and is open every day. Every piece here is IGI and SGL certified lab grown diamond jewellery, set in BIS hallmarked gold and sterling silver, so you can check the certificate before you buy. Walk in to try on rings, earrings, bracelets and necklets, or book a visit and we will have your shortlist ready.

Book an Appointment

Book a visit and our team will set aside time for you, with styling help, a walkthrough of each diamond's certificate, and ring and bracelet sizing. Shopping for Dhanteras or Diwali? Book ahead so your pieces are sized and ready before the festive rush.

Inside Keemti

A closer look at our store and fine jewellery.

Shop Lab Grown Diamond Jewellery in Mumbai at Keemti Andheri

Mumbai has plenty of places to buy jewellery, but few where every diamond on display is lab grown and certified. At our jewellery shop in Andheri West, you can try on everyday rings, stud and hoop earrings, bolo and tennis bracelets, and fine neckwear, then compare them side by side. Each piece comes with its IGI or SGL certificate, and the team will explain cut, clarity and carat weight in plain terms.

Prices start under ₹5,000, so this jewellery store in Mumbai suits a first diamond or a quick gift as much as an engagement ring. If you are comparing jewellery shops in Mumbai for lab grown diamonds, the simplest test is to see them in person. Prefer to browse first? Shortlist pieces online, then try them on here, and decide for yourself whether we are the best jewellery shop in Mumbai for certified lab grown diamonds.

Festive Gifting at Keemti Andheri

Dhanteras falls on 6 November this year, followed by Diwali on 8 November, then Diwali Padwa, and Bhai Dooj on 11 November. If a diamond is on your list, visit early. For Padwa, solitaire studs or a slim bolo bracelet make a gift your partner can wear every day. For your mother or sister, look at necklets and hoops under ₹20,000, or step up to statement pieces under ₹50,000.

Visiting Andheri West in person means you can try pieces on, check each certificate and get rings sized before the big day. Browse all diamond gifts, or read our Diwali gifting guide.

Frequently Asked Questions

What are the opening hours at the Andheri West store?

The store is open Monday to Sunday, 11:00 AM to 8:30 PM.

Do I need an appointment to visit Keemti in Mumbai?

No. You can walk in any day during store hours. Booking ahead means the team can keep your shortlist ready and set aside time for certificates and sizing.

Are the diamonds at Keemti Andheri certified?

Yes. Every lab grown diamond at Keemti Andheri is IGI and SGL certified, and the gold is BIS hallmarked. Ask to see the certificate for any piece you try on.

Is there parking near the Andheri West store?

The store is at New Link Palace, near Kamat Club in Oshiwara. Call +91 865 263 5939 before you visit and the team will point you to the nearest parking.

Can I exchange or collect an online order at the Mumbai store?

Keemti offers lifetime exchange and buyback. To exchange or collect an online order at Andheri West, call the store with your order number first so the team can check it and have it ready.

What are good Diwali Padwa gifts from Keemti Andheri?

Solitaire stud earrings, eternity rings and bolo bracelets are easy to wear every day and make thoughtful Padwa gifts. Pieces start under ₹5,000, and the team can help you choose within your budget.
